explanation: Encodes Erdős's classical grid lower bound f_2(n) > n^{1+c/log log n} for all large n, where f_d(n) is the maximum number of unit pairs among n points in ℝ^d. This is a true, well-known result, valid for all large n since f is monotone and grids exist at every scale. erdosproblems.com/1085 now reports a much stronger n^{1+c} bound for infinitely many n (OpenAI), but that does not make this statement wrong.
